subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: Should the exact current head be authorized to move the internal @openclaw/matrix dependency from qa-matrix into qa-lab and land the associated gateway-lifecycle seam?
rationale: Repository policy deliberately requires human authorization for dependency-graph changes, and the same branch includes a production gateway admission change whose ownership cannot be inferred from green CI alone.

options.title: Authorize the current head
options.body: Approve the internal workspace dependency move and land after confirming the gateway restart boundary is intentional; this matches runtime ownership and preserves the compatibility shim.

options.title: Split the production seam
options.body: Require the gateway admission change to land separately before authorizing the otherwise QA-focused migration.

options.title: Pause the migration stack
options.body: Keep the branch open without dependency authorization if maintainers do not want QA Lab to own the Matrix runtime yet.

recommendation.title: Authorize the current head
recommendation.body: Approve the internal workspace dependency move and land after confirming the gateway restart boundary is intentional; this matches runtime ownership and preserves the compatibility shim.

likelyOwner.reason: The dependency guard explicitly requires repository-admin or secops authorization for the current head.
